subject: MultimodalChat kickoff — photo suggestion in conversation
body:
Hi Alina,

Kickoff for MultimodalChat. Base asset is the PhotoChat dataset from our open-source release: dialogues where every turn carries a share_photo boolean and user_id, plus a photo_description with object labels and the photo's Open Image ID. That gives us two trainable tasks out of the box — (1) predict the turn where a photo share is appropriate, (2) retrieve the right photo given dialogue context.

Product framing: rich-content suggestion (photos/GIFs/stickers) inside the language portfolio's chat surfaces. The share-intent trigger is the differentiator; retrieval alone is table stakes.

Milestones: Open Image data pulled and indexed by mid-May, intent + retrieval baselines by end of June, end-to-end demo for Launch Review Board in late July. Window closes 08-03 so there's not much slack after that demo.

Staffing plan from you when ready?

Priya
